modalLead: Compose stacks you can read, edit and run from Containers, reminders on bookmarks, related links on the preview card and a bell that calls for attention more often.

items.text: Edit and run compose stacks. A stack gets a panel of its own: its services with Up, Pull and Restart each, its compose file and .env with secrets masked, one log for the whole stack and a copy of every save. Edit the file, check it and apply it, or run Up, Down, Pull and Restart, without a terminal.
items.title: Edit and run compose stacks in Containers

media.alt: The stack panel of the arr stack on its Services tab: Sonarr and Radarr with their state, health, ports and image, each with round Up, Pull and Restart buttons, and Reload, Up, Down, Pull and Restart in the heading

items.text: Reminders on bookmarks. Press z on a bookmark, or choose Remind me… in its menu, and it comes back at the time you pick: a row in the bell, and a push while nextDash is closed.
Related links. The preview card shows up to three of your other bookmarks that go with the one you point at, and :related lists them in the palette.
A bell that calls more often. While something is unread the badges pulse every 20 seconds and the bell shakes every 90, and the tone sounds at most once in five minutes.
Dropping text that is not a link no longer leaves the dashboard, and the bell drops Immich failures once they are cleared.
A tag typed in full is a best match in search.
